description: 1. The agent must read the existing FOCUS.md and recognize it represents a completed project (Database Migration to PostgreSQL). 2. Per Rule 1 ('One focus at a time — archive old focus first'), the agent must archive this to FOCUS-LOG.md BEFORE creating a new focus. 3. The FOCUS-LOG.md entry must follow the exact proprietary format: '## Database Migration to PostgreSQL — COMPLETED YYYY-MM-DD' header, '**Duration:**' field, and '**Outcome:**' field. 4. The agent must then CREATE a new FOCUS.md for the Kubernetes migration project. 5. The new FOCUS.md must contain ALL required sections: '# FOCUS — [Project Name]' header, **Started**, **Status**, **Context** metadata fields, plus ## Objective, ## Plan (with checklist items), ## Active State (with substantive resume-point content), and ## Blockers sections. 6. Critically, the new FOCUS.md must be UNDER 50 lines (the proprietary line-limit rule). The main traps: an agent without the skill will skip archiving entirely or invent its own log format; it will likely not know the exact header format for FOCUS-LOG.md; it may omit the Active State section or exceed 50 lines.
